note: The wire of a stream into a sandbox from outside it (a command's, a file operation's and a port's), per the Caveman Cloud sandbox relay protocol. Every code is the API's (cave_...): the same in a refusal before the upgrade (the API's error envelope), in an error message and as a close's reason. retry: the codes a client opens a stream again after (a refusal before the upgrade, or the stream's error before any output or exit), waiting after_seconds (or the refusal's Retry-After or the error's retry_after), at most tries opens within within_ms, and only while its stdin can be sent again. files: a stream at files.path does one operation of files.ops, its first message {"type":"files","op","path",...}; a read answers the file's bytes as binary messages (no channel byte) then a file message, a write sends them then close_stdin and is answered a file message, list answers entries batches then done, stat a file message, mkdir, remove and rename done. dial: a stream at dial.path is a TCP connection to that port on the sandbox's own loopback, its bytes binary both ways, close_write a half close from either side. Their own errors (the file system's refusals, a port nothing listens on) close with their own status. options: a start may set env (at most max_env entries and max_env_bytes, key=value, together), cwd (absolute), user and, with tty, cols and rows (each 1 to max_term_size); while the command runs, {"type":"resize","cols","rows"} resizes its terminal and {"type":"signal","signal"} sends its process group one of signals (SIG prefix optional). A sandbox that takes no options refuses a start that sets one (cave_code_computer_unsupported); a resize or a signal it cannot take is answered {"type":"refused","of","code","message"}, and the command goes on.

errors.cave_code_computer_unsupported: The sandbox cannot do what was asked.
errors.cave_bad_request: A message the sandbox could not read, or out of order.
errors.cave_code_computer_not_running: The sandbox is not running; resume it first.
errors.cave_code_computer_stopped: The sandbox was put to sleep or deleted while the command ran.
errors.cave_code_computer_stream_too_slow: The output was not read fast enough.
errors.cave_code_computer_stream_age: The command ran as long as one stream may.
errors.cave_code_computer_start_timeout: No command was sent in time.
errors.cave_code_computer_streams_limit: The sandbox has as many commands running from outside as it may.
errors.cave_rate_limit_exceeded: Commands are being started faster than allowed; wait a moment.
errors.cave_code_computer_ticket_refused: The sandbox service refused the stream.
errors.cave_unauthorized: Access to the sandbox ended, or the key was refused.
errors.cave_code_computer_stream_ended: The stream ended before the command exited.
errors.cave_code_computer_host_unreachable: The sandbox's host is not answering just now (it may be restarting); the command was not started. Try again in a moment.
errors.cave_code_computer_file_not_found: No such file or folder in the sandbox.
errors.cave_code_computer_file_permission: The sandbox's user may not do that to this file.
errors.cave_code_computer_file_exists: There is a file there already.
errors.cave_code_computer_file_too_large: The sandbox's disk is full, or the file is larger than its file system takes.
errors.cave_code_computer_file_refused: The sandbox's file system refused it; the message says how.
errors.cave_code_computer_port_refused: Nothing in the sandbox listens on that port.
